text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you both for your help. I never 
imagined you would even carry my bags for 
me...!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No need for thanks. After all, I'm the one 
who lost the bet to Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The loser has to do one thing Meno says... 
Heh heh, that was quite the heated gamble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you really are a softie. Going out 
of your way to help with the neighborhood 
association's Christmas party and all.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It's all for the children's 
smiles, after all. Going out to buy 
presents is no trouble at all!
choice_data_list:
It might not be much, but I'll lend a hand 
too.

It might not be much, but I'll lend a hand 
too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
First, we should purchase stationery, yes. 
A pencil set seems like a good choice, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Is this perhaps a bit too safe of a 
choice? I wonder if the children will 
truly enjoy it...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ha, playing it safe is boring anyway. If 
we're making a choice, let's be more 
aggressive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If we're doing this, a present that'll 
get the runts totally hyped would be way 
more fun...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...?! A-are you alright, sir?! 
Gifts that are too intense might be...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Like... Battle Pencils, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"The rules are pretty intricate lately, so 
there's real depth to it. The little brats 
will get totally fired up too... Heh."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Indeed, incorporating an element of 
fun might make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what's with that face? Looks 
like you're really stressing over 
something, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me. I'm looking for an 
educational toy to give as a gift... but 
there are just so many varieties.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph, is that so? In that case... Balance 
games usually go over pretty well."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"That tension of wondering when it'll 
collapse... Heh heh, just the right thrill 
for the runts."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
! I see, that thought never even crossed 
my mind...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To think you possess such valuable 
information... Um! If you don't mind, 
would it be all right if I asked you a few 
questions?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Make it quick.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of these presents is 
wonderful...! Thank you so much, 
Nakayama-san!
choice_data_list:
To think you know so much about kids' 
stuff...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
True, it is a bit surprising, but... could 
it be—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Is that because of your younger siblings?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Mom wouldn't stop nagging me to help 
get things ready for the little squirts.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Big Sis! Ta-da, roller skates! 
Santa brought them for me♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
I got a globe! This is the one I've wanted 
for so long. ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm, I see. Good for you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, take good care of it. It's a gift 
from old Santa, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Sister & Brother
text_block_list.text: Ready, and... Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, the chicken is ready! 
...Thanks for helping out. Eat up and get 
your fill!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's not like I did anything big. ...But—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Having beef tripe stew ain't bad at all. 
Nothin' beats this in the winter, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My word... What a wonderful older sister 
she is!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ha. If I do nothing, Mom's just gonna nag 
me anyway.
choice_data_list:
So you spent Christmas with your family, 
huh?

So you spent Christmas with your family, 
didn't you?

Getting presents for your younger siblings 
again this year?

Are you getting presents for your younger 
siblings again this year?

text_block_list.text:
Ha. If I do nothing, Mom's just gonna nag 
me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ain't like I had anything better to do. 
...Though that's all in the past now.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
True, since I live in the dorms now, it 
will probably be a different kind of 
Christmas compared to when I lived with my 
family.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Golshi mentioned 
something. About preparing a "Holy Night 
Mystery Hot Pot Party" or whatever... 
Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! What a dangerous party...! This 
officer must keep a close watch!

...A few days later, Nakayama Festa also 
joined in on the mystery hot pot party, 
thoroughly enjoying Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about this? Would you 
join me at the neighborhood association's 
party?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, an active racer, the children 
are sure to be delighted!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Kids, huh... ...Hmph. Might be fun to bet 
on whether I can actually enjoy myself.

Later on, Nakayama Festa attended the 
neighborhood association's Christmas 
party, spending a Christmas Eve quite 
different from her usual ones.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In that case, for Christmas... let's get 
into the holiday spirit and join in on a 
lively event.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Goodness...!? Could it be that you're 
interested in such things...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's the other way around. Let's make 
a bet... on whether I can actually enjoy 
something I have zero interest in.

...A few days later, after Christmas had 
passed, Nakayama Festa simply reported 
with a bored expression, "The bet was a 
loss."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Mom and Dad gave me a strict warning about 
it, after all. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"With stuff like this, it's best to just 
buy it and send it off quick."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, don't tell me that's from your 
siblings...!? Gah, how regrettable. If 
only you had told me, I would have gladly 
helped!
